newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai exports up 31.8 pct in first two months.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai exports up 31.8 pct in first two months.

text.p: Shanghai posted $3.431 billion of exports in the first two months of 1997, up 31.8 percent from the same 1996 period, the official Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
Exports by foreign invested firms in Shanghai during the period hit $1.313 billion, up 38.4 percent from the same 1996 period, the Xinhua said.
The city's exports of mechanical and electronic products registered dynamic growth of 53.3 percent to $1.09 billion dollars in the period, it said.
